name: How much resale value does an ADU add in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: Does an ADU actually increase property value enough to justify the construction cost?
mainEntity.text: Does an ADU actually increase property value enough to justify the construction cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: An ADU can raise resale value because it adds functional living space and more ways to use the property. Buyers often value a unit that feels private, well designed, and easy to access, especially in dense Los Angeles neighborhoods where flexible housing is in demand. But the value uplift is not automatic. A cramped, awkward, or poorly finished ADU may contribute less than a well-planned unit with good light, storage, and separation from the main home. Homeowners should think about long-term market appeal rather than only monthly rent. A well-executed ADU tends to be more attractive when the architecture feels like it belongs to the property and the site work is clean. The strongest value cases usually come from a thoughtful design that balances function, privacy, and curb appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: An ADU can increase value by adding usable living space, rental potential, and flexibility for future owners, but the value increase depends on site quality, design, privacy, and neighborhood demand. A poorly placed or awkward ADU may add less value than a well-designed one.
